notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello, we are happy to be able to release a part of our gameplay as an early access demo. We are still actively developing the game and the features are far from complete, but we wanted to release something early to gauge reactions and get an idea of what we are doing right.

We are a small team, and we're actively trying to improve. We hope you laugh and enjoy the demo for what it is, comedy. We're happy to receive any feedback, whether negative or positive. You don't need to worry about hurting our feelings haha. So feel free to tell us how shitty our game is, we don't mind.

Having said that, we are still waiting on the review process and wanted to make a few last minute changes to the demo. The demo should be available in 7-9 days. We look forward to seeing how gay you guys get *wink* *wink*.

Yours truly,
Why Are You Games Team
